questions.stem: A 0.1 mol/dm³ solution of HCl has pH 1, while a 0.1 mol/dm³ solution of ethanoic acid has pH 3. Why is the pH different?

options.text: Ethanoic acid has a higher molar mass
HCl fully ionises, releasing more H⁺ ions; ethanoic acid only partially ionises
Ethanoic acid reacts with water to form a base

questions.explanation: Both acids have the same concentration, but HCl is a strong acid that fully ionises, producing many H⁺ ions and a low pH. Ethanoic acid is a weak acid that only partially ionises, producing fewer H⁺ ions and a higher pH.
